{{Quote|Ziro was here. He was holding one of those cups.|[[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], using his psychometry abilities to track down [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]]|<ref name="Hunt for Ziro">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>}}
'''Psychometry''', also known as '''postcognition''', '''''tai vordrax'''''<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> or '''telemetry''', was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that was a mental technique of picking up impressions and traces of information about the object touched and the events that have surrounded it.

==Description==
{{Quote|Somehow you are 'seeing' all these things. Any idea how: clairvoyance, telepathy, psychometry&hellip;|Lando Calrissian, to Mohs|<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>}}
This power allowed the user to view events as if they were there, including the sights, sounds, and feelings, both emotional and physical, that the wielder of the object experienced. This power was easier to use on personal objects that were used frequently. Objects that were used once or by several people often made the use of this power difficult, though it was still possible. This skill was useful for tracking, though it was not useful in open battle and would fail to render useful information at times.

Sometimes this power caused its user's eyes to glow.<ref name="The Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

The power could taint the user if the object had been used to execute [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]]-related actions, like murder. Wielders of the dark side could use it on living beings, [[Drain Knowledge|ripping memories]] from their brains.

The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] strongly discouraged the use of psychometry on dead bodies, as the emotions prior to a violent death were so strong that the deceased would have likely brushed with the dark side. This endangered Jedi by exposing them to these powerful emotions. Additionally, at the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the Jedi Council frowned upon excessive use of this power, as it allowed the user to experience intense emotions, which might make them more susceptible to the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Extreme cases caused the psychometric's mind to become trapped, and rarer still, caused death.

==Users==
[[File:VosTrackingZiro-HFZ.png|thumb|left|250px|Quinlan Vos uses psychometry to track his quarry.]]
About one in one hundred [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] were able to use this [[Force power/Legends|power]]. The Vos line of Kiffar had more than their share of psychometrics. Most with this ability became [[Kiffu Guardians]]. [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] often used psychometry, being the Kiffar of his time most skilled at it.

The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Boc Aseca]] was adept with this skill.

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] considered psychometry as one of the possible explanations for the ability of [[High Singer of the Toka]] [[Mohs]] to perceive the world around him after his blinding in the [[Great Pyramid]] on [[Rafa V]].<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu" />

As a young man, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] visited the [[Valley of the Spirits]]. His untrained psychometric abilities gave him enough insight into the [[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|massacre]] that he could read some of the scene and know where [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker Lars]] had been restrained. The experience unsettled him to the point where he described it as "worse than a nightmare."

Years later, when [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was kidnapped by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] as part of an attempt to woo her, Luke Skywalker used this ability to track Han's emotional "scent" to the casino where he had won the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] from the [[Drackmarian]] warlord [[Omogg]].
